findings.finding: The SYN-EX-01 correction example records 20 daily sign-in entries deduplicated to 11 unique learner-class associations, but provides no day-by-day or learner-level breakdown, so the deduplication cannot be independently reproduced from the document text alone.
findings.effect: Limits standalone verifiability of one synthetic correction demonstration; does not affect annual totals, growth rates, or the correction-record format.
findings.bounded_remedy: Add a small synthetic day-by-day/learner breakdown or explicitly label the example as illustrative-only and reproducible only from preserved REAL sign-in sources; keep the example excluded from annual totals.

note: F1 is a non-blocking synthetic-example reproducibility limitation; it is excluded from annual totals and does not justify changing the candidate.
